findings.exact_supporting_passage: Community Action Services and Food Bank (CASFB) will temporarily close its doors effective November 1, 2026.
findings.summary: CASFB's current official homepage states it will temporarily close its doors effective November 1, 2026, reflecting a material food-access disruption. A November 3 local Park Record report, surfaced via Utah.News, says its Heber City pantry has shut and Oakley and Coalville locations are temporarily closed, with Christian Center of Park City filling gaps. A separate CASFB status page last updated October 27 says the Provo/Oakley/Coalville pantries remained open and Heber would close mid-November; the two provider pages conflict. Do not imply every pantry closure or count affected households as resolved without direct new confirmation.
